gaps.normative_requirement: The measured power input shall be assessed against the rated power input.
gaps.finding_reason: The declared rating is 400 W, but the appended table identifies a 2,500 W rating and 2,580 W measurement; attribution to the declared model is unresolved.
gaps.required_action: Establish sample identity and provide a valid power-input assessment against its marked rating.

gaps.normative_requirement: Measured temperature rises shall not exceed the applicable limits.
gaps.finding_reason: The heating table records an internal-wire rise of 61.9 K against its own 35 K limit; this is an objective failure despite the inconsistent table verdict and product attribution.
gaps.required_action: Investigate the failure and retest an identified representative sample after corrective action.

gaps.normative_requirement: Compliance is established by fulfilling relevant requirements and carrying out relevant tests.
gaps.finding_reason: The report includes washing-machine-unrelated instruction and marking text, a displaced clause reference and inconsistent verdicts, casting doubt on template and result attribution.
gaps.required_action: Replace or correct the report with a traceable washing-machine assessment and verified verdicts.

gaps.normative_requirement: An appliance marked with rated power input shall be assessed against Table 1.
gaps.finding_reason: The clause is marked N/A despite the 400 W marking; the contradictory appended table does not establish compliance for that rating.
gaps.required_action: Measure and assess input at rated voltage under normal operation.

gaps.normative_requirement: Normal heating is assessed over the specified operating cycles with relevant temperature rises monitored.
gaps.finding_reason: Heating is marked N/A, while a temperature table and a qualitative pass appear; the applicable cycle, loading, ambient, limits and complete valid results are not established.
gaps.required_action: Perform and document the complete heating test on the identified appliance.

gaps.normative_requirement: Relevant tests of 21.101, 21.102 and 22.104 shall use the appliance used for Clause 18 testing.
gaps.finding_reason: The report does not establish sample allocation or the required common test specimen.
gaps.required_action: Identify specimens and document the required test sequence and sample linkage.

gaps.normative_requirement: Washing machines shall have at least IPX4 protection.
gaps.finding_reason: Classification is passed without an identifiable IP rating or specific IPX4 result.
gaps.required_action: Record the classification and substantiate it with the applicable ingress test.

gaps.normative_requirement: The IP number, other than IPX0, shall be marked on the appliance.
gaps.finding_reason: IP marking is marked N/A although the supplied Part 2 requires at least IPX4.
gaps.required_action: Verify and document the required IP marking on the appliance.

gaps.normative_requirement: Appliances without automatic water-level control require maximum-level marking, and applicable cold-supply appliances require a hot-water caution.
gaps.finding_reason: The report does not identify water-level control, heating or supply arrangements sufficiently to assess the Part 2 markings.
gaps.required_action: Establish applicability and document the required markings or justified exclusions.

gaps.normative_requirement: If the off position is indicated only by letters, the word "off" shall be used.
gaps.finding_reason: The extracted report contains "OF" and an F verdict in the control-position area, but the attribution and actual marking are unclear.
gaps.required_action: Clarify the F verdict and verify the actual off-position marking against Part 2.

gaps.normative_requirement: Instructions shall specify the maximum mass of dry cloth in kilograms and the specified safe-use statements.
gaps.finding_reason: The instruction assessment passes unrelated text but does not document the dry-cloth mass or the supplied standard’s supervision statements.
gaps.required_action: Submit and assess the actual instructions against 7.12.

gaps.normative_requirement: Installation instructions shall address precautions and, where applicable, unobstructed base ventilation openings.
gaps.finding_reason: No report row establishes whether base ventilation openings are present or whether the required carpet warning applies.
gaps.required_action: Inspect the construction and document the applicable installation instructions.

gaps.normative_requirement: Type Y appliances require the specified damaged-cord replacement instruction.
gaps.finding_reason: Type Y attachment is declared, but no 7.12.5 instruction assessment is reported.
gaps.required_action: Verify and record the required Type Y cord-replacement instruction.

gaps.normative_requirement: Water-mains appliances require applicable pressure instructions, pressure and backsiphonage assessment, and compliant detachable hose-sets.
gaps.finding_reason: These requirements are marked N/A without establishing whether the washing machine is intended for water-mains connection.
gaps.required_action: Establish the water connection arrangement and complete the applicable assessments or document the exclusions.

gaps.normative_requirement: Required markings shall be durable and located as specified.
gaps.finding_reason: The report addresses a hot-surface symbol instead of marking durability and marks the main-part location requirement N/A.
gaps.required_action: Assess marking durability and location on the actual appliance.

gaps.normative_requirement: Leakage current and electric strength shall be checked at operating temperature after the specified operating period.
gaps.finding_reason: The operating sequence is unsubstantiated, the leakage table has unclear supply and result attribution, and no operating-temperature electric-strength values are identified.
gaps.required_action: Provide traceable operating-temperature conditions, measurements and electric-strength results.

gaps.normative_requirement: Applicable clearances shall meet Table 16 or, where permitted, withstand the impulse test.
gaps.finding_reason: Clause 14 is N/A and the clearance table gives only broad distances without identifying measured locations, exposure to movement or the basis for excluding impulse tests.
gaps.required_action: Identify and measure critical clearances and perform any applicable impulse tests.

gaps.normative_requirement: The enclosure shall withstand the ingress test appropriate to its classification and subsequent electric-strength assessment.
gaps.finding_reason: Generic IP test text is passed, but the selected IP level, test method and configuration are not recorded; the IPX4 configuration is marked N/A.
gaps.required_action: Perform and document the applicable IPX4 or higher test and subsequent checks.

gaps.normative_requirement: Spillage testing shall include the Part 2 filling or overflow procedure and the specified treatment over the appliance.
gaps.finding_reason: A generic spillage statement is passed without the applicable overflow, detergent, top-spillage, control-operation or subsequent inspection details.
gaps.required_action: Conduct and document the applicable Part 2 spillage procedure and subsequent checks.

gaps.normative_requirement: Foaming shall not affect insulation, as verified by the specified cycle and electric-strength test.
gaps.finding_reason: The washing-machine foaming test has no report row or result.
gaps.required_action: Perform and document the foaming test and subsequent electric-strength test.

gaps.normative_requirement: Door or lid interlocks and applicable braking mechanisms shall withstand their specified endurance cycles.
gaps.finding_reason: No endurance assessment is reported; the door or lid construction and any opening during extraction are not established.
gaps.required_action: Identify the construction and complete the applicable endurance tests.

gaps.normative_requirement: Appliances incorporating motors shall undergo the applicable stalled-condition test.
gaps.finding_reason: The motor-operated test condition is recorded, yet locked-rotor testing and its results are N/A.
gaps.required_action: Perform and record the applicable stalled-condition tests for each motor.

gaps.normative_requirement: Applicable series-motor appliances are tested at 1.3 times rated voltage for one minute.
gaps.finding_reason: The report passes the series-motor row using 254.4 V, whereas 1.3 × 240 V is 312 V; actual motor type is not established.
gaps.required_action: Confirm motor type and, if applicable, test at 312 V for one minute.

gaps.normative_requirement: Applicable electronic circuits require fault evaluation and relevant electronic-disconnection or protective-circuit tests.
gaps.finding_reason: Clause 19 passes the presence of electronic-circuit testing, but 19.11 is N/A and no fault evaluation is documented.
gaps.required_action: Identify the circuits and complete or justify exclusion of each applicable electronic fault and immunity test.

gaps.normative_requirement: The specified washing-machine faults and, where applicable, hot-water abnormal operation shall be assessed.
gaps.finding_reason: Neither Part 2 abnormal-operation clause is reported; the appliance’s water and heating arrangements are insufficiently identified.
gaps.required_action: Establish applicability and perform the relevant Part 2 abnormal tests.

gaps.normative_requirement: Abnormal testing shall meet the specified safety criteria, including the Part 2 textile and interlock requirements.
gaps.finding_reason: The generic pass does not record textile ignition, charring or glowing, or the applicable post-test interlock checks.
gaps.required_action: Document the Part 2 abnormal-test observations and post-test checks.

gaps.normative_requirement: Stability testing uses closed doors and lids and the most unfavourable castor position.
gaps.finding_reason: The report repeats the Part 1 open-or-closed condition without identifying the actual door, lid or castor configuration.
gaps.required_action: Document the stability test using the applicable Part 2 configuration.

gaps.normative_requirement: Applicable drum machines require unbalanced-load and door or lid interlock safety assessments.
gaps.finding_reason: No Part 2 mechanical-hazard rows are reported, and drum type, extraction speed and interlock arrangement are not identified.
gaps.required_action: Characterize the drum and interlock and complete the applicable mechanical-hazard tests.

gaps.normative_requirement: Lids and doors shall have adequate mechanical strength and applicable lids shall resist distortion.
gaps.finding_reason: No Part 2 lid or door strength assessment is reported, and the closure construction is not established.
gaps.required_action: Identify the closure and perform the applicable strength and distortion tests.

gaps.normative_requirement: Insulation shall be protected from condensation or leakage, and appliances containing liquid require safeguards against excessive pressure.
gaps.finding_reason: Both clauses are N/A without a construction-based explanation for this washing machine.
gaps.required_action: Inspect the liquid system and assess or justify exclusion of each requirement.

gaps.normative_requirement: Applicable washing-machine construction shall protect against water discharge, textile contact with heaters and unsafe opening of interlocks.
gaps.finding_reason: No Part 2 construction rows establish applicability or compliance for the door, filter, heater and interlock arrangements.
gaps.required_action: Inspect the construction and perform the applicable Part 2 checks and interlock tests.

gaps.normative_requirement: Components shall meet applicable IEC safety requirements and be assessed in their conditions of use.
gaps.finding_reason: The component table lists a 220 V plug for the declared 240 V appliance without establishing its suitability at the appliance rating.
gaps.required_action: Identify the actual plug and demonstrate its suitability for the rated supply.

gaps.normative_requirement: Applicable switches and automatic controls require assessment to their relevant standards and specified operating cycles.
gaps.finding_reason: A switch is listed, but no switch-cycle assessment is reported; the presence and rating of a door or lid interlock are also unresolved.
gaps.required_action: Identify safety-relevant controls and provide their applicable cycle evidence or tests.

gaps.normative_requirement: Supply connection, attachment method and cord type shall meet the applicable construction requirements.
gaps.finding_reason: No rows assess the means of supply connection, Type Y attachment construction or cord-type suitability.
gaps.required_action: Inspect and document the applicable supply connection, attachment and cord requirements.

gaps.normative_requirement: Supply-cord inlet openings shall protect the cord and have applicable insulation or bushings.
gaps.finding_reason: The inlet requirement is N/A despite the declared Type Y supply cord, with no construction-based explanation.
gaps.required_action: Inspect the inlet and verify its cord protection and applicable bushing insulation.

gaps.normative_requirement: Appliances require effective external-conductor connections with the specified terminal accessibility.
gaps.finding_reason: The general terminal requirement is marked N/A without identifying the actual connection construction.
gaps.required_action: Inspect external-conductor connections and document terminal accessibility.

gaps.normative_requirement: On corded appliances, current-carrying conductors shall become taut before the earthing conductor if the cord slips.
gaps.finding_reason: The corded-appliance requirement is N/A despite the Class I Type Y supply connection.
gaps.required_action: Inspect and document conductor lengths and routing at the cord anchorage.

gaps.normative_requirement: Earthing resistance shall not exceed 0.1 Ω at the specified test current.
gaps.finding_reason: The report records 0.027 Ω but does not identify the applied current, source voltage or tested accessible parts.
gaps.required_action: Record the test current, source and each assessed earthing path.

gaps.normative_requirement: Relevant electrical and earthing connections shall retain contact pressure and be secured against loosening.
gaps.finding_reason: Both general connection requirements are N/A without identifying the connections or demonstrating that exclusions apply.
gaps.required_action: Inspect the electrical and earthing connections and document compliance or justified exclusions.

gaps.normative_requirement: Creepage assessment shall account for working voltage, material group and the Part 2 pollution and CTI requirements.
gaps.finding_reason: The report cites the Part 1 pollution-degree default but does not establish the Part 2 exposure exceptions, CTI values or measured creepage locations; the functional table is N/A.
gaps.required_action: Identify insulation locations, exposure, CTI, working voltages and measured creepage distances.

gaps.normative_requirement: Supplementary and reinforced insulation shall be verified by an applicable thickness, layer or electrical-strength route.
gaps.finding_reason: Clause 29.3 is passed while all listed verification subclauses are N/A; the applicable route and results are not identified.
gaps.required_action: Identify each insulation system and document its applicable verification route and results.

gaps.normative_requirement: Relevant non-metallic and insulating parts shall withstand the applicable ball-pressure test.
gaps.finding_reason: The clause is passed, but the ball-pressure table is N/A and contains no part, temperature or impression result.
gaps.required_action: Test or substantiate each applicable part and record the results.

gaps.normative_requirement: Applicable non-metallic parts and PCB materials shall meet the specified fire-resistance tests or documented alternatives.
gaps.finding_reason: The report passes fire clauses but the appended table identifies only a switch enclosure and does not establish the full part selection, test severity, material alternatives or consequential tests.
gaps.required_action: Provide a part-by-part fire assessment with test results or valid material evidence.

gaps.normative_requirement: Relevant tests are required to support the compliance assessment.
gaps.finding_reason: The stated report date, Apr.10.2026, precedes the end of the stated test period, Apr.17.2026; a separate issue date is also Apr.17.2026.
gaps.required_action: Clarify and correct the report and issue dates with laboratory authorization.

gaps.normative_requirement: The power-input deviation shall be determined from the rated and measured inputs.
gaps.finding_reason: The repeated 2,500 W and 2,580 W values give +3.2%, not the reported +6.7%, +7.3% or +10.0%.
gaps.required_action: Correct the calculations and identify each measurement.

gaps.normative_requirement: Required instructions and text shall be in an official language of the country of sale.
gaps.finding_reason: The language requirement is marked N/A and the destination market is not identified.
gaps.required_action: Identify the market and verify the language of the required text.

gaps.normative_requirement: Appliances shall not incorporate mercury-containing components other than lamps.
gaps.finding_reason: The prohibition is marked N/A without documenting component inspection.
gaps.required_action: Verify the component construction and record compliance.

gaps.normative_requirement: The supplied evaluation basis is the stated IEC Part 1 and Part 2 requirements.
gaps.finding_reason: The report claims US IEC editions, but the supplied material does not establish whether US deviations were applied or how they relate to the evaluated IEC texts.
gaps.required_action: Identify the exact standards and deviations used and reconcile the assessment with the supplied IEC basis.

final_summary.evaluation_conclusion: The submitted report does not demonstrate compliance with the supplied IEC requirements. Its recorded temperature-limit failure is decisive, while the conflicting power rating, incomplete Part 2 assessments and document-integrity defects independently prevent a reliable compliance decision.
final_summary.recommended_action: Resolve the measured failure and sample identity, complete the applicable assessments and issue a traceable replacement report before certification proceeds.
